note: The principles the engine enforces, said once. The README is generated from this (corpus/readme.py), and so is anything else that states them - the company's site reads it from the release it pins. `*word*` is emphasis, in every place this is rendered. skills/wherefore/SKILL.md says how to work by each one, which is guidance about these and not a second copy of them.

principles.rule: A fact exists in exactly one place.
principles.says: Everything else is generated from it or checked against it.
Nothing in the build path calls a model.
A change the build cannot handle stops it; nothing improvises.

principles.rule: A check is not trusted until it has been shown to fail.

principles.says: Every tracked file is *generated*, *authored* or *captured*. Generated files are never hand-edited, and a capture is stamped with what it was made from.
